_note: Paths are new doors into scenes that already exist: nothing here adds to the story. Each stop plays the scenes from `from` to `to` (story order; `to` may be left out for one scene) and returns to the path. Lines describe only what those scenes already tell, in the narration's own plain words; write "God" (the Muslim view shows Allah). npm test checks every id.

paths.title: Women the Quran remembers
paths.blurb: Mothers, a queen and believers whose stories the Quran tells.

stops.title: Hawwa
stops.line: Beside Adam in the Garden, in the mistake, and in the turning back to God.

stops.title: Hajar
stops.line: Left in a barren valley with her infant, she says: then God will not abandon us.

stops.title: Sarah
stops.line: In her old age she is given the son the angels promised.

stops.title: The mother of Musa
stops.line: She sets her baby on the river, trusting God's promise to return him.

stops.title: Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh
stops.line: In Pharaoh's own palace she believes, and asks for a house near God.

stops.title: The Queen of Saba
stops.line: She ruled a land that bowed to the sun. Then she came to Sulayman's palace.

stops.title: The mother of Maryam
stops.line: A mother's vow, and a girl provided for from where no one expected.

stops.title: Maryam
stops.line: The angel's news, the palm tree, and the child who speaks for her.

paths.title: Creatures in the stories
paths.blurb: A crow, an ant, a whale, a dog: the animals that carry a lesson.

stops.title: The crow
stops.line: A crow scratches at the earth, and a man learns from it.

stops.title: The she-camel
stops.line: A sign that came out of the rock, and the water she shared with a people.

stops.title: The four birds
stops.line: Ibrahim asks to be shown how God gives life to the dead.

stops.title: The ram
stops.line: A father and a son both obey, and a ram stands in the boy's place.

stops.title: The seven cows
stops.line: A king's dream that no one at his court can explain.

stops.title: The yellow cow
stops.line: A people who answer one simple command with question after question.

stops.title: The ant and the hoopoe
stops.line: An ant warns her valley, and a bird brings news of a distant queen.

stops.title: The small creature of the earth
stops.line: It gnaws through a staff, and the jinn learn they never knew the unseen.

stops.title: The whale
stops.line: Yunus in the darkness, calling on God.

stops.title: The birds of clay
stops.line: Isa shapes birds from clay and they fly, by God's permission.

stops.title: The dog of the cave
stops.line: Young men asleep for three centuries, their dog stretched across the entrance.

stops.title: The donkey
stops.line: A man, his food and his donkey, after a hundred years.

paths.title: Dreams and what they meant
paths.blurb: Five dreams, and how each one came true.

stops.title: Ibrahim's dream
stops.line: He sees himself sacrificing his son, and asks the boy what he thinks.

stops.title: Yusuf's dream
stops.line: Eleven stars, the sun and the moon, and a father's advice to keep it from his brothers.

stops.title: The prisoners' dreams
stops.line: Before he explains their dreams, Yusuf speaks to them of God.

stops.title: The king's dream
stops.line: Seven fat cows eaten by seven lean ones, and a court with no answer.

stops.title: The dream comes true
stops.line: Years later the family bows before Yusuf, and he forgives.

paths.title: When they called on God
paths.blurb: Prayers made in the hardest moments, and how they were answered.

stops.title: Adam and Hawwa
stops.line: After the mistake they blame no one. They turn back to their Lord.

stops.title: Ayyub
stops.line: Years of loss and illness, then one call to his Lord.

stops.title: Musa at the well
stops.line: A stranger with nothing, sitting in the shade: my Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send me.

stops.title: Asiya
stops.line: My Lord, build for me a house near You in Paradise.

stops.title: Sulayman
stops.line: He hears an ant, smiles, and thanks God for His favour.

stops.title: Yunus
stops.line: From inside the whale: there is no god but You.

stops.title: Zakariya
stops.line: An old man asks quietly, in the night, for an heir.

stops.title: The young men of the cave
stops.line: Our Lord, grant us mercy from Yourself, and guide us rightly.
